name: Zombie Simulator
desc:
Welcome to Zombie Simulator! In here you have to become the biggest and strongest zombie of them all!

You need to consume your brain while finding better ones to eat!
Collect energy to get a boost!
Rebirth to get multipliers!

If you find any bugs or glitches join the group and let me know!
Don't forget to like and favorite the game!

Created and published in 1 week by @scratchy_GoId.
